roadmap.title: First day
roadmap.description: Survive a day and night, tame your first dinosaur and ride it.

roadmap.title: Exploration and first goals
roadmap.description: Cure Swamp Fever, uncover the mini-map, reach the high and low points, ride a T-Rex and start collecting Explorer Notes.

roadmap.title: Guardians and collectibles
roadmap.description: Collect the Artifacts and Dossiers, level a dinosaur, ride a Giganotosaurus, defeat the three Island guardians and keep collecting notes.

roadmap.title: Late game
roadmap.description: Reach max survivor level, clear the Center guardians, Gamma and Beta ascensions.

roadmap.title: Endgame
roadmap.description: Complete the Alpha Ascension, tame every creature and collect every Explorer Note.

achievements.description: You found the Dossiers of each of ARK's initial Specimens!
achievements.summary: Find all of Helena's Dino Dossiers.

guide.context: Dossiers are Explorer Notes about single creatures. They appear on The Island and on the Scorched Earth, Aberration and Extinction maps. Some are in caves or behind waterfalls, such as the Archaeopteryx dossier at Winter's Mouth.

steps.text: Find each creature dossier on the map by walking or flying into it.
Tame a creature if its dossier unlocks that way, such as the Carcharodontosaurus.

achievements.description: You defeated ARK's first Guardian!
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix} while in her boss arena.

guide.context: You only need to be near her in the arena when she dies. Up to 10 survivors and 20 ground creatures can enter, and each creature must weigh under 560 drag weight.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Artifact of the Clever}, @item{Artifact of the Hunter} and @item{Artifact of the Massive}.
At player level 30 or higher, put them in an @mechanic{Obelisk} or @mechanic{Supply Crate} and press Generate Portal.
Enter the arena and defeat @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix}.

achievements.description: You personally retrieved all the Artifacts!

guide.context: The Island has 10 Artifacts. Clever, Hunter and Massive are for Broodmother Lysrix; Brute, Devourer and Pack are for Megapithecus; Cunning, Immune, Skylord and Strong are for the Dragon. A looted Artifact must go into your own inventory.

steps.text: Clear each cave and the other remote spots that hold an Artifact crate.
Take every Artifact from its crate yourself.
Use the pulsing distortion on cave walls to tell when an Artifact is nearby.
steps.note: If a looted crate stays and blocks a respawn, restart the server.

achievements.description: You defeated ARK's second Guardian!
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Megapithecus} while in his boss arena.

guide.context: You only need to be near him in the arena when he dies. Up to 10 survivors and 20 ground creatures can enter, and each creature must weigh under 560 drag weight.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Artifact of the Brute}, @item{Artifact of the Devourer} and @item{Artifact of the Pack}.
At player level 45 or higher, put them in an @mechanic{Obelisk} or @mechanic{Supply Crate} and press Generate Portal.
Enter the arena and defeat @enemy{Megapithecus}.

achievements.description: You defeated ARK's third Guardian!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Dragon} while in its boss arena.

guide.context: You only need to be near it in the arena when it dies. Up to 10 survivors and 20 ground creatures can enter, and each creature must weigh under 560 drag weight.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Artifact of the Cunning}, @item{Artifact of the Immune}, @item{Artifact of the Skylord} and @item{Artifact of the Strong}.
At player level 55 or higher, put them in an @mechanic{Obelisk} or @mechanic{Supply Crate} and press Generate Portal.
Enter the arena and defeat the @enemy{Dragon}.

achievements.description: You've defeated ARK's three Guardians! And yet...
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix}, @enemy{Megapithecus} and the @enemy{Dragon} in their boss arenas.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks once all three have died with you near them in their own arenas.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix} in her arena.
Defeat @enemy{Megapithecus} in his arena.
Defeat the @enemy{Dragon} in its arena.

achievements.description: You Survived a full day and night on the ARK!
achievements.summary: Survive one full day and night cycle on the ARK.

steps.text: Stay alive until a full day and a full night have passed.

achievements.description: You Tamed a Dinosaur!

steps.text: Knock a dinosaur out, for example by punching it, then put suitable food in its inventory until the taming finishes.
Stay close until the "You tamed" message appears.
steps.note: The message does not appear if you are far away when the taming completes.

achievements.description: You Rode a Dinosaur!

steps.text: Tame a dinosaur that can be ridden and mount it.

achievements.description: You reached the Maximum Survivor Level!

guide.context: The maximum is 105 with no bonuses. Alpha ascensions add 15 levels each, all Explorer Notes add 10, Fjordur runes add 10 and a level-6 Chibi-Pet adds 5, so the cap is higher once you have earned them.

steps.text: Keep gaining experience until your survivor stops at its level cap.

achievements.description: One of your Dinosaurs reached Maximum Level!
achievements.summary: Level one of your tamed dinosaurs to its maximum level.

guide.context: The dinosaur only needs 88 level-ups after its tamed or bred level. It does not have to be a top-level wild creature.

steps.text: Tame or breed a dinosaur.
Keep it gaining experience and level it up 88 times.

achievements.description: You rode on the back of a T-Rex!

steps.text: Tame a @enemy{Rex}.
Mount it.

achievements.description: You rode on the back of a Giganotosaurus!

steps.text: Find and tame a @enemy{Giganotosaurus}.
Mount it.

achievements.description: You uncovered more than 80% of the Mini-Map!

steps.text: Travel across the map, on foot, by mount or by air, until the mini-map shows over 80% explored.

achievements.description: You've reached the highest mountain peak of the ARK!
achievements.summary: Stand on the tallest mountain peak of the ARK.

steps.text: Climb or fly to the top of the highest mountain peaks on the map, one after another, until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: You've reached the bottom of the ARK's oceans!
achievements.summary: Get to the ocean floor at the deepest point of the ARK.

steps.text: Dive down to the lowest point of the sea bed.

achievements.description: You've cured yourself of Swamp Fever!
achievements.summary: Cure yourself of @mechanic{Swamp Fever} using a @item{Lesser Antidote}.

guide.context: Wearing a Gas Mask blocks airborne Swamp Fever, and leveling up clears diseases, so drink the antidote before you gain a level.

steps.text: Catch @mechanic{Swamp Fever} by touching a @enemy{Diseased Leech} or from an infected human or tamed @enemy{Dodo} nearby.
Learn the @item{Lesser Antidote} engram at level 18 and harvest @item{Leech Blood} from leeches.
At a Mortar and Pestle, craft the antidote from 3 Leech Blood or Horns, 5 Narcoberry, 1 Narcotic, 10 Rare Flower, 10 Rare Mushroom, 1 Raw Meat and 1 Spoiled Meat.
steps.note: It spoils in 3 days, so craft it close to when you need it.

steps.text: While you have @mechanic{Swamp Fever}, use the @item{Lesser Antidote}.

achievements.description: You Ascended off the ARK, at Gamma level!
achievements.summary: Ascend off the ARK at Gamma difficulty.

guide.context: Tributes are not consumed. The Tek Cave door stays open for 5 minutes, then you have 60 minutes to clear the cave and start the @enemy{Overseer} fight. Put Element and other items that cannot be uploaded into a tamed creature's inventory before the final countdown ends.

steps.text: Defeat Gamma @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix}, @enemy{Megapithecus} and the @enemy{Dragon} to earn their trophies.
At player level 60 or higher, bring the three Gamma trophies to the @loc{Tek Cave} at the @loc{Volcanic Maw} on the @loc{Volcano} summit.
Clear the @loc{Tek Cave}, then defeat the @enemy{Overseer} on Gamma.

achievements.description: You Ascended off the ARK, at Beta level!
achievements.summary: Ascend off the ARK at Beta difficulty.

guide.context: Ascend Gamma before Beta. Tributes are not consumed. The Tek Cave door stays open for 5 minutes, then you have 60 minutes to clear the cave and start the @enemy{Overseer} fight. Put Element and other items that cannot be uploaded into a tamed creature's inventory before the final countdown ends.

steps.text: Defeat Beta @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix}, @enemy{Megapithecus} and the @enemy{Dragon} to earn their trophies.
Collect an @item{Alpha Raptor Claw}, @item{Alpha Carnotaurus Arm} and @item{Alpha Tyrannosaur Tooth}.
At player level 80 or higher, bring the three Beta trophies and those three items to the @loc{Tek Cave}.
Clear the @loc{Tek Cave}, then defeat the @enemy{Overseer} on Beta.

achievements.description: You Ascended off the ARK, at Alpha level!
achievements.summary: Ascend off the ARK at Alpha difficulty.

guide.context: Ascend Gamma, then Beta, then Alpha; ascending at a lower difficulty after Alpha breaks the character profile. Tributes are not consumed. The Tek Cave door stays open for 5 minutes, then you have 60 minutes to clear the cave and start the @enemy{Overseer} fight. Put Element and other items that cannot be uploaded into a tamed creature's inventory before the final countdown ends.

steps.text: Defeat Alpha @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix}, @enemy{Megapithecus} and the @enemy{Dragon} to earn their trophies.

Collect an @item{Alpha Raptor Claw}, @item{Alpha Carnotaurus Arm}, @item{Alpha Tyrannosaur Tooth}, @item{Alpha Megalodon Fin}, @item{Alpha Mosasaur Tooth}, @item{Alpha Tusoteuthis Eye} and @item{Alpha Leedsichthys Blubber}.
At player level 100 or higher, bring the three Alpha trophies and those seven items to the @loc{Tek Cave}.
Clear the @loc{Tek Cave}, then defeat the @enemy{Overseer} on Alpha.

achievements.description: You discovered 10% of the Explorer Notes on the ARK!

guide.context: Count every note on The Island. Also count the Genesis and Genesis 2 Chronicle notes if HLN-A is available to you. Beating the @enemy{Overseer} unlocks the Bosses and Epilogue entries. Extinction Chronicles do not count.

steps.text: Walk or fly into Explorer Notes until you have found 10% of them.

guide.context: Count every note on The Island. Also count the Genesis and Genesis 2 Chronicle notes if HLN-A is available to you. Beating the @enemy{Overseer} unlocks the Bosses and Epilogue entries. Extinction Chronicles do not count.

steps.text: Walk or fly into Explorer Notes until you have found 100% of them.
Beat the @enemy{Overseer} so the Bosses and Epilogue notes unlock, then collect them.

achievements.description: You tamed all of the domesticable creatures on the ARK!
achievements.summary: Tame every domesticable creature on the ARK.

guide.context: Each creature must be tamed by you while you are nearby. Claimed babies, bred babies and claimed adults do not count. Every creature on the list can also be found on Lost Island.

Tame Araneo, Archaeopteryx, Argentavis, Arthropluera.
Tame Baryonyx, Basilosaurus, Beelzebufo, Brontosaurus.
Tame Carbonemys, Carcharodontosaurus, Carno, Castoroides.
Tame Chalicotherium, Compy, Daeodon, Dilophosaurus.
Tame Dimetrodon, Dimorphodon, Diplocaulus, Diplodocus.
Tame Dire Bear, Direwolf, Dodo, Doedicurus.
Tame Dung Beetle, Dunkleosteus, Electrophorus, Equus.
Tame Gallimimus, Giant Queen Bee, Giganotosaurus, Gigantopithecus.
Tame Hesperornis, Hyaenodon, Ichthyornis, Ichthyosaurus.
Tame Iguanodon, Kairuku, Kaprosuchus, Kentrosaurus.
Tame Liopleurodon, Lystrosaurus, Mammoth, Manta.

Tame Megatherium, Mesopithecus, Microraptor, Mosasaurus.
Tame Moschops, Onyc, Otter, Oviraptor.

achievements.description: You defeated the Guardians of The Center!

guide.context: The Center is free DLC. Its boss arena holds @enemy{Broodmother Lysrix} and @enemy{Megapithecus} together, and both must be defeated. Entry level is 70 on Gamma, 80 on Beta and 90 on Alpha.

steps.text: Install The Center and gather the Artifacts and tribute for its boss arena.
Open the arena portal at an @mechanic{Obelisk} or @mechanic{Supply Crate}.
Defeat both bosses in the arena.
